title: Brain Tumor MRI Classification & Benchmark (IEEE ICONICA 2026)
description: Published IEEE research (DOI: 10.1109/ICONICA70605.2026.11736701) benchmarking advanced CNN architectures (EfficientNetV2, DenseNet121, ResNet50V2) for multi-class brain MRI diagnosis (Glioma, Meningioma, Pituitary, Normal). Attained state-of-the-art 98.92% accuracy, 0.9999 Macro-AUC, 100% specificity on healthy tissue, and Grad-CAM spatial heatmap localization for clinical explainability.

title: AI Career Mentor
description: Architected a full-stack AI career mentoring application powered by Google Gemini API, React 19, TypeScript, Vite, and Node.js/Express with MongoDB Atlas. Features personalized career roadmaps, skill radar assessments, and dynamic resume optimization.

title: AI Study Portal
description: Built a collaborative academic library and syllabus QA portal with FastAPI, React 18, and an AI-powered FAISS RAG engine. Includes hierarchical course discovery, domain-restricted student authentication, vetted peer contributions, and admin review workflows.

title: Financial Fake News Detector
description: Engineered an intelligent financial misinformation detection web app utilizing a fine-tuned DistilBERT transformer model. Provides real-time news credibility prediction with confidence scoring, market sentiment classification, and secure history logging with FastAPI & MongoDB.

title: LandfillPlume-AI Gas Forecasting
description: Developed a machine learning and Explainable AI (SHAP) platform fusing satellite methane observations with 70,000+ DPCC ground sensor records. Features real-time Gaussian plume dispersion modeling, toxic gas concentration forecasting (LightGBM/XGBoost), and resident safe-zone alerts.
